name: Cu Chi veal
summary: Cu Chi veal is fine-grained and red, with a mild sweetness. It is also called tender, and soft and fragrant.
origin: Củ Chi. The tourism center calls it local veal. Người Lao Động says farms raise the cattle on a grass of this district. Tuổi Trẻ says cattle raised in Củ Chi.
howToEat: It is local veal, cooked into several plates. The named plates are separate.
Unnamed chefs on one account choose animals of about 5–6 months. Farms on another account feed them a grass of this district.
The hour is Check on arrival.

taste: The meat is fine-grained and red, with a mild sweetness. It is also called tender, and soft and fragrant.
